opsAnalyticsQuery.sql: SELECT DISTINCT JSON_VALUE(json_payload.source) AS source FROM `__PROJECT__.global._Default._AllLogs` WHERE log_name = 'projects/__PROJECT__/logs/control-table' AND timestamp >= TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 7 DAY) ORDER BY source LIMIT 1000

SELECT COUNTIF(JSON_VALUE(json_payload.status) = 'FAILED') AS failed FROM `__PROJECT__.global._Default._AllLogs` WHERE log_name = 'projects/__PROJECT__/logs/control-table' AND timestamp >= TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 7 DAY) AND IF(@Source = '*', TRUE, JSON_VALUE(json_payload.source) = @Source) AND JSON_VALUE(json_payload.date) = (SELECT MAX(JSON_VALUE(json_payload.date)) FROM `__PROJECT__.global._Default._AllLogs` WHERE log_name = 'projects/__PROJECT__/logs/control-table' AND timestamp >= TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 7 DAY))

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT IF(JSON_VALUE(json_payload.status) = 'FAILED', JSON_VALUE(json_payload.unit), NULL)) AS books_hit FROM `__PROJECT__.global._Default._AllLogs` WHERE log_name = 'projects/__PROJECT__/logs/control-table' AND timestamp >= TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 7 DAY) AND IF(@Source = '*', TRUE, JSON_VALUE(json_payload.source) = @Source) AND JSON_VALUE(json_payload.date) = (SELECT MAX(JSON_VALUE(json_payload.date)) FROM `__PROJECT__.global._Default._AllLogs` WHERE log_name = 'projects/__PROJECT__/logs/control-table' AND timestamp >= TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 7 DAY))

SELECT JSON_VALUE(json_payload.source) AS source, COUNT(*) AS failed FROM `__PROJECT__.global._Default._AllLogs` WHERE log_name = 'projects/__PROJECT__/logs/control-table' AND timestamp >= TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 7 DAY) AND JSON_VALUE(json_payload.status) = 'FAILED' GROUP BY source ORDER BY failed DESC

widget.title: Failed runs per hour, by source

opsAnalyticsQuery.sql: SELECT TIMESTAMP_TRUNC(timestamp, HOUR) AS hour, JSON_VALUE(json_payload.source) AS source, COUNT(*) AS failed FROM `__PROJECT__.global._Default._AllLogs` WHERE log_name = 'projects/__PROJECT__/logs/control-table' AND timestamp >= TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 7 DAY) AND JSON_VALUE(json_payload.status) = 'FAILED' AND IF(@Source = '*', TRUE, JSON_VALUE(json_payload.source) = @Source) GROUP BY hour, source ORDER BY hour

widget.title: Where it failed and how widely (business date × source × system)

opsAnalyticsQuery.sql: SELECT JSON_VALUE(json_payload.date) AS business_date, JSON_VALUE(json_payload.source) AS source, JSON_VALUE(json_payload.system) AS system, COUNTIF(JSON_VALUE(json_payload.status) = 'FAILED') AS failed, COUNTIF(JSON_VALUE(json_payload.status) = 'RUNNING') AS running, COUNT(*) AS runs, COUNT(DISTINCT IF(JSON_VALUE(json_payload.status) = 'FAILED', JSON_VALUE(json_payload.unit), NULL)) AS books_hit, ANY_VALUE(IF(JSON_VALUE(json_payload.status) = 'FAILED', JSON_VALUE(json_payload.error), NULL)) AS example_error FROM `__PROJECT__.global._Default._AllLogs` WHERE log_name = 'projects/__PROJECT__/logs/control-table' AND timestamp >= TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 7 DAY) AND IF(@Source = '*', TRUE, JSON_VALUE(json_payload.source) = @Source) GROUP BY business_date, source, system HAVING failed > 0 ORDER BY business_date DESC, failed DESC LIMIT 200
